import paramiko
import time
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Checkout fix/esm-stable and reset to origin
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git checkout fix/esm-stable && git reset --hard origin/fix/esm-stable 2>&1 | tail -3")
print("Branched:", stdout.read().decode())
# Apply fixes again
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria && git log -1 --oneline")
print("Commit:", stdout.read().decode())
time.sleep(2)
# Upload firebase
with open('/workspace/project/wasd-clone/server/src/config/firebase.ts', 'r') as f:
    local_code = f.read()
sftp = client.open_sftp()
with sftp.file('/opt/areloria/server/src/config/firebase.ts', 'w') as f:
    f.write(local_code)
print("Firebase uploaded")
sftp.close()
# Remove brace - exact line fix
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -i '1451,1452d' /opt/areloria/server/src/core/WorldTick.ts")
client.close()
EOF
